section_reviews.notes: NoArgs, NoDuplicateArgs and ArbitraryArgs error descriptions align; generic branch wording and answer word cap require separate assessment.

Both FAQ answers say an empty ValidArgs list causes an error, contradicting the len(ValidArgs)>0 gate and nil fallthrough. Additional invented cannot-determine/error-suggestion reasoning is absent from source.

FAQ says ExactArgs factory returns nil for matching argument count. Factory returns a validator; that returned validator returns nil. Unordered-bound uncertainty is not behavior enforced by factories.
Deprecation is correctly described, but first-error short circuit is not explained and the empty-list caveat is omitted.
FAQ says HasParent plus nonempty args returns an error; source requires !HasParent, reversing root/child behavior.

format_hypothesis: Structural completion improved in this bounded run; source correctness did not. Combined intervention, same family, no general causal claim.
